story:
An angel, a long donkey ride, a little stable and a baby in a manger: Jesus is born! Grandpa Sol tells the Christmas story to Zara, Eli and Pip, with a sing-along song at the end. Christmas is about Jesus, God's greatest gift. (Luke 2)

Memory verse: "Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord." Luke 2:11
Memory line: Jesus is God's gift to us!

Talk about it together:
- Ages 2-3: Where did baby Jesus sleep? (In a manger!)
- Ages 4-8: Who told the shepherds the good news? What did the shepherds do next? What is the best gift God gave us?

Prayer: Dear God, thank You for sending Jesus. He is the best gift of all. Help us to love Him and tell others. Amen.

Activity: Draw a picture of baby Jesus in the manger and a star, and tell someone why Jesus is God's gift.

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Mary rode a donkey, slow and sweet
Joseph walked beside on tired feet
Bethlehem was full, no room, no bed
But a little stable was ready instead

[Chorus]
Jesus is born, Jesus is born
On a quiet starry Christmas morn
Angels sing and shepherds run
God sent His love, His own dear Son!

[Verse 2]
Shepherds on the hillside, shining light
"Do not be afraid," the angels said that night
"Glory to God, and peace on earth
Come and see the baby, born with joy and mirth!"

[Chorus]
Jesus is born, Jesus is born
On a quiet starry Christmas morn
Angels sing and shepherds run
God sent His love, His own dear Son!

[Chorus - lifted]
Jesus is born, Jesus is born
On a quiet starry Christmas morn
Angels sing and shepherds run
God sent His love, His own dear Son!

[Outro]
Glory to God!
